title: Bluestone State Park Pool Replacement
overview: The pool sits within the Bluestone Lake flood plain and had suffered total basin failure. MEI devised a first-of-its-kind local approach allowing an empty basin to flood intentionally so it can't 'float' when the lake rises. The project replaced the basin, wading pool, and equipment, reconfigured the austere beach area for more sunbathing space, and added an arched-spray mountain fountain to the wading pool.
